The Red Year (4)
I must begin by asking, when Border Patrol and Ice were under orders from the Biden administration to wave in and ignore tens of millions of illegal immigrants did the “right” carefully plan and execute terror attacks as presumed protest? Were there riots in the street to protest? You know the answer.
Violence Against Federal Immigration Law Enforcement (1)
This is the first of two Posts given the scope and depth of political violence under this topic.
Los Angeles ICE Riots
In June, significant riots occurred in Los Angeles in response to ICE actions to arrest and deport illegal immigrants.
Democrat Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass said as much on Monday
[on CNN], after two days of foreign nationals[hurling boulders]at cop cars, setting private property on fire, and[tossing explosives]at federal government facilities. “I just have to say that if you dial back time and go [back] to Friday,” she said, “if immigration raids had not happened here, we would not have the disorder that went on last night.”The “immigration raids” Bass referred to were multiple Immigration and Customs Enforcement
[detention operations]throughout the city for the purpose of apprehending migrants residing in the U.S. illegally. That’s an ancient process in L.A. now formerly known as “upholding the law.” In effect, Bass was arguing that so long as illegal aliens were permitted to break the law, there would be no problems.She said that with a straight face on live national television. So, no, they don’t get to disavow anything. This is their mess, and they won’t clean it up, which means someone else has to.
Make no mistake, the Democrat leadership from Washington D.C. to Los Angeles to every two-bit politician not only didn’t oppose this rioting, but in many cases openly encouraged and supported it.
What we’re seeing in L.A. is what Democrats instigate and excuse when their policies are obstructed. They’re happy with it. This is how they govern, and to pretend otherwise is an insult to even below-average intelligence…
And, so, absolutely unsurprisingly, the violence escalated.
Alvarado, Texas ICE Ambush
The most serious domestic terror attack on ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement) occurred on July 4, 2025 at a federal facility in Alvardo Texas.
Ten members of an armed mob accused of attacking an ICE detention center on July 4th have been charged by the Department of Justice with attempted murder.
The assailants allegedly wore military-style gear, including tactical vests, and launched fireworks at the Prairieland Detention Center near Dallas before spraying bullets at a local cop and unarmed federal agents, according to the criminal complaint filed Monday.
One suspect unloaded 20 to 30 rounds at two detention center workers, prosecutors said, and a police officer for the town of Alvarado took a gunshot to the neck area.
The mug shots of these ten accused tells the story of who is at the point of the spear of domestic terrorism. They are almost all Caucasian, under the age of 40, with the majority female. But make no mistake, these Democrat shock troops are supported morally, organizationally and financially by an army of over-40 year old barbarians.
This operation was carefully planned and executed by a cohesive, organized group of individuals. Law enforcement was lured out of the facility by use of fireworks and vehicle vandalism. Once the ICE and police officers were visible they opened fire with the clear intent to murder as many as possible.
Here’s an excerpt from U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Northern District of Texas in a press release.
“The defendants, dressed in black military-style clothing, began shooting fireworks at the facility, as part of an organized attack. After approximately 10 minutes of convening, one or two individuals broke off from the main group and began to spray graffiti on vehicles and a guard structure in the parking lot at the facility. An Alvarado police officer responded to the scene after correctional officers called 911 to report suspicious activity. When the Alvarado police officer arrived, one alleged defendant positioned in nearby woods shot the officer in the neck area. Another alleged assailant across the street fired 20 to 30 rounds at unarmed correctional officers who had stepped outside the facility.”
The graffiti read “ICE pig” and “F*ck you pigs.”
This incident was planned to be a mass murder event. Fortunately, the execution was so poor that no one was seriously injured, let alone killed. But, the intent was backed by careful organization and planning. And yet, the Corporate Media barely acknowledged this massive escalation in domestic terrorism.
McAllen, Texas ICE Ambush
I’m going to scale back on the detail from here on in order to limit this Post’s length.
This attack occurred on July 7, just three days after the above discussed Alvarado attack.
There’s been another attack on Border Patrol agents, this time in McAllen, Texas. Fox News’ Bill Melugin reports,
Three federal & TX law enforcement sources tell me an active shooter with a rifle & tactical gear ambushed Border Patrol agents as they arrived at a Border Patrol annex facility in McAllen, TX this morning. Local police and federal agents returned fire, killing him.
Melugin added, “I’m told this was a purposeful ambush/attack against federal agents and a press conference is planned for later this morning.”
While no Border Patrol agents were injured, there are reports that a police officer was shot in the firefight. He is said to be in stable condition.
Dallas TX ICE Ambush
A third ambush attack on ICE personnel occurred in September.
Three detainees shot, including at least one fatally, at Dallas ICE facility, officials announce. The suspected attacked, identified by sources to Fox News as 29-year-old Joshua Jahn, died after turning the gun on himself, authorities said. …
Acting ICE Director Todd Lyons said the Dallas field office shooting was a calculated sniper attack aimed at law enforcement, warning the alleged gunman’s anti-ICE motives and escalating rhetoric against the agency pose growing dangers to officers, detainees, and the public.
“It wasn’t directed at the detainees, it wasn’t directed at civilians on the street. It was a definite attack on law enforcement. He was there to attack that building,” Lyons told Fox News’ Martha MacCallum on Wednesday.
He emphasized that the alleged shooter, identified as Joshua Jahn, specifically fired on ICE vehicles and the facility itself.
And yet, the purposeful, cold-blooded incitement to murder of ICE agents continues unabated by Democrats, from the top of the nation’s political system down to its grass root activists and supporters.
“For months, we’ve been warning politicians and the media to tone down their rhetoric about ICE law enforcement before someone was killed,” Noem said. “This shooting must serve as a wake-up call to the far-left that their rhetoric about ICE has consequences. Comparing ICE day-in and day-out to the Nazi Gestapo, the Secret Police, and slave patrols has consequences.”
Those consequences are NOT unintended.
